description: Defines the AddressSorterPosix class for sorting IP addresses based on policies and network change notifications, including related structures and enums.

classes.name: AddressSorterPosix
classes.description: Implements address sorting based on explicit policies, not thread-safe, completes synchronously, and observes network IP address changes.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of IP endpoints based on policy and network conditions, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when the IP address changes, updating internal source address info.

methods.name: FillPolicy
methods.description: Populates address info based on policy tables for a given IP address.

methods.name: FinishedSort
methods.description: Completes the sorting process for a given sort context.
